summary: Independent review correction: PL-0741's Windows qualification collector emits an unsanitized raw sidecar.log tail despite its NO SECRETS acceptance. sidecarLog() returns tail: text.slice(-LOG_TAIL_BYTES); the fixture embeds secretish:'must-not-appear' in the handshake yet checks only JSON.stringify(log.handshake), not JSON.stringify(log) or the full report. Therefore test passes while report.sidecarLog.tail contains the test secret. Keep the task in REVIEW/return to IN_PROGRESS for a correction: remove or safely sanitize the raw tail, retain diagnostic absence/error categories, and assert fixture secret does not appear anywhere in full serialized report. Do not claim any Windows runtime pass.
